name: Breedon

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single-story residence with a dark multi-gable roof|A paved driveway leads to the front of the house|A detached outbuilding with a light-colored roof is located toward the rear of the lot|Open grassy lawn, mature trees, and landscaped plantings surround the structures|The property is located in a residential area bordering open fields.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows a single-story home with a dark roof and attached garage area|A paved driveway holds a vehicle|Landscaped plantings and a front lawn are present|Mature trees frame portions of the front and side yards.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the side elevation of the home and portions of the open rear yard|Mature trees and open grassy areas are present|A detached outbuilding is visible toward the rear of the property.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back elevation of the home|A large open lawn extends toward a detached outbuilding|Mature trees and landscaped plantings are distributed throughout the rear yard|Pathways and open ground connect the main house to the rear structure.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side of the home and open grassy areas|Mature trees and landscaped plantings are present|Portions of the rear yard and detached outbuilding are visible from this angle.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway that leads from the street to the front of the residence. The front of the property is open and clearly accessible. A large open lawn extends behind the main house and provides substantial space for movement and staging. Mature trees are present throughout the lot but do not fully enclose the structures. A detached outbuilding is located toward the rear of the property. Neighboring homes are present on adjacent lots.
clarifications: Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the property or rear yard? Is vehicle or pedestrian access available to the rear of the house and the detached outbuilding?
